questions.questionHtml:
After interchanging the given two numbers and two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively?

× and ÷, 7 and 9

I. 8 × 3 ÷ 6 + 9 – 7

II. 9 – 7 × 1 + 6 ÷ 3
questions.solution:
BODMAS rule:

I. 8 × 3 ÷ 6 + 9 – 7

After interchanging '× and ÷' and '7 and 9'

8 ÷ 3 × 6 + 7 – 9

⇒ 16 + 7 - 9

⇒ 23 - 9 = 14.

II. 9 – 7 × 1 + 6 ÷ 3

After interchanging '× and ÷' and '7 and 9'

⇒ 7 – 9 ÷ 1 + 6 × 3

⇒ 7 – 9 + 6 × 3

⇒ 7 – 9 + 18

⇒ 25 - 9 = 16.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be correct? × and +
questions.questionHtml:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be correct?

× and +
questions.solution:
BODMAS rule:

Option 1) 7 × 8 ÷ 9 + 18 – 11 = 16.

After interchanging '× and +'.

⇒ 7 + 8 ÷ 9 × 18 – 11 = 16

⇒ 7 + 0.8 × 18 – 11 = 16 

⇒ 7 + 14.4 – 11 = 16 

⇒ 21.4 – 11 = 16

⇒ 10.4 ≠ 16 

Option 2) 24 – 8 – 5 × 5 + 3 = 14.

After interchanging '× and +'.

⇒ 24 – 8 – 5 + 5 × 3 = 14 

⇒ 24 – 8 – 5 + 15 = 14 

⇒ 39 – 8 – 5 = 14 

⇒ 26 ≠ 14

Option 3) 5 × 10 – 15 + 20 ÷ 25 = 8.

After interchanging '× and +'.

⇒ 5 + 10 – 15 × 20 ÷ 25 = 8 

⇒ 5 + 10 – 15 × 0.8 = 8

⇒ 5 + 10 – 12 = 8

⇒ 15 – 12 = 8 

⇒ 3 ≠ 8

Option 4) 24 × 8 + 6 ÷ 3 – 18 = 22.

After interchanging '× and +'.

⇒ 24 + 8 × 6 ÷ 3 – 18 = 22 

⇒ 24 + 8 × 2 – 18 = 22 

⇒ 24 + 16 – 18 = 22

⇒ 40 – 18 = 22

⇒ 22 = 22  

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

We apply the options to the given equation and solve it using BODMAS rule:

⇒ 248 ÷ 8 + 184 ÷ ( 4 × 6 – 2 × 4) = 77

⇒ 248 ÷ 8 + 184 ÷ (24 – 8) = 77

⇒ 248 ÷ 8 + 184 ÷ 16 = 77

⇒ 31 + 11.5 = 77

⇒ 42.5 ≠ 77.

⇒ 248 ÷ 4 + 77 ÷ (24 – 16) = 184

⇒ 248 ÷ 4 + 77 ÷ 8 = 184

⇒ 62 + 9.6 = 184

⇒ 71.6 ≠ 184.

Given equation: 248 ÷ 4 + 184 ÷ ( 4 × 6 – 2 × 8) = 77

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Right to Property.

  • Article 300A
    • Article 300A  deals with the Right to Property.
    • Article 300A states that no person shall be deprived of his property, save by the authority of law.
    • The right to property was declined from the Fundamental Right after the 44th Constitutional Amendment Act, of 1978.
    • After the amendment, it was made a legal right under Article 300A in PART-XII of the Constitution.
    • The Supreme Court reminded Government that the state had to follow the due procedure of law before taking the private property of a person.

questions.solution: Crystal field theory (CFT) explains the relationship between ligand bonding and degradation of d orbitals in metal complexes, the geometry of metal complexes, and the splitting of d orbitals. It governs how ligands interact with the central metal atom or ion and views the interaction as an electrostatic phenomenon. CFT considers the partially covalent nature of bonding between the ligand and metal atom. The theory explains how the d orbitals split apart and become non-degenerate due to the varied symmetries of the d orbitals and the inductive influence of the ligands on the electrons.

questions.question: Which of the following is caused by exogenic force?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is caused by exogenic force?
questions.solution: Erosion is caused by exogenic forces which originate from outside the earth's surface, such as water, wind, and waves. These forces wear away the surface of the earth, leading to the removal of soil, rocks, and other materials. This process is known as denudation, and it is a significant factor in shaping the earth's landscape. Endogenic forces, on the other hand, originate from within the earth and can cause events like earthquakes and volcanoes. Therefore, the correct answer is erosion, which is caused by exogenic forces.

questions.question: Which of the following greenhouse gases is most abundant in the atmosphere?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following greenhouse gases is most abundant in the atmosphere?
questions.solution: • Water vapour is the most abundant greenhouse gas in the Earth's atmosphere. We are encouraged

P. help accelerate their return to

Q. by how women are embracing online

R. work and promote economic mobility

S. learning to develop new skills that can
questions.solution: The correct answer is: A. QSPR. The sentence begins with "We are encouraged," which is logically followed by "by how women are embracing online" (Q). This leads to what they are embracing: "learning to develop new skills that can" (S). These skills then "help accelerate their return to" (P) a specific destination, which is "work and promote economic mobility" (R).
